Fear of racism leads to anger, anger leads to hate and hate... leads to suffering.

Let me tell you my story about racism...

So grew up in America not knowing racism but I am not white or black. There were a few times when I thought oh maybe that guy is being racist but then I was like nah, no way. So one day I was talking to a co-worker who's wife happens to be the same race as I am and he said they had to sue the school district because they were being racist towards his wife.

Then I was like whoa, so how'd you know they were being racist and he goes on to describe it and I realize, "Hey I've experienced shit like that before!". I tell him a couple of stories I had and my co-worker said you've experienced racism and I was like damnit and felt like shit.

So then for a month I would start to perceive things I used to not care about as being racist to me. Like when some white person crossed over to the other side of the street or when I would be at the check out and the white person wouldn't say anything while they already made conservation with the person in front of me. Hell I bought a new house and when I moved in both my neighbors promptly moved out! I was starting to get paranoid, did I not get accepted to grad school because of my race??? I stated to get angry like fuck this shit and white people... and I started to preempt the "racism" i perceived.

Then it dawned on me, I wasn't this way before.. I was actually at peace... Sometimes I start up a conversation with the check out people and sometimes they ignore me, I didn't give a shit before. It didn't even cross my mind about people avoiding me at times, I always kinda thought I had bitch/angry face anyway. Then I realized you know what the stories I told my co-worker, I had checked that off in my mind that the people in those stories were just assholes before he mentioned that they were being racist. Yup they used to JUST be assholes :)

That made me feel so much better because I know that everyone regardless of the color of their skin can be an asshole and I know that not everyone is an asshole! I stopped feeling that hate swell inside of me and went back to the way I perceived the world before I thought it was racist... a world where some people are just assholes.

TLDR So in short I'm over racism, I don't know if it exists or not but I totally don't give a shit. Nor do I give a shit about races plight either and how they wish to make it a science/art and understand the nuances of racism as this author has. Because a racist is just an asshole and I think similar to the Dark Side of the force (LOL dark...) if you perceive people as racist it just becomes a self fulfilling prophecy. I'm totally over it and I'm at peace, but these folks will never be. Their fear of racism starts them down the path...
